entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Force of habit, si-- Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "Force of habit, si-- Anton."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: "About goddamn time."

entries.dialogueText: "Before I begin, I have to ask if you're sure you wish to follow through on this investigation. After all, Tusk has been an ally throughout your term."

entries.dialogueText: "I've got to finish getting ready."
entries.menuText: "I've got to finish getting ready."

entries.dialogueText: Lucian smiled tightly, but didn't answer the question.

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm ready if you are, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm ready if you are, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll see you at the rally.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you at the rally."

entries.dialogueText: A few hours later, I was waiting in the wings at the Norsord Auditorium in Anrica. In the audience were several thousand of my conservative supporters.

entries.title: Player_Italic: ""Victory Is Close.""
entries.dialogueText: "Victory Is Close."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic

entries.dialogueText: "Your Land. My Land. Sordland."

entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone cheered as I walked onstag..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone cheered as I walked onstage -- except for a scowling Mayor Curtan Leste. He had tried to escape my shadow by joining the NFP, only to be defeated once more when our parties became allies.
